name: Bracken of Moonburrow
lore: A fox sapper from Moonburrow Hollow, guarding the moonstone warrens from unstable mines and the restless Warren King.

primary.name: Moonstone Mines
primary.description: Clicks one and two plant a mine nearby in your aim direction. Click three detonates both for 38 damage each within 95 units. Mines expire after 12 seconds.

secondary.name: Burrow Bloom
secondary.description: Three ground eruptions advance along your aim. Each deals 12 damage and slows enemies for 1.5 seconds.

special.name: Foxfire Escape
special.description: Teleport up to 280 units along your aim, stopping before walls. Leave a glowing bomb at your old position; after 1 second it explodes for 62 damage within 115 units.

passive: Wide Fuse: mine explosions gain 20 units of radius.

technique.name: Clockwork Grenades
technique.description: Throw up to three timed grenades. They explode after 1.4s without a detonation click, dealing 20% less damage. Reach becomes 190.

final_technique.name: Burrow Cover
final_technique.description: Place a 3s burrow field with six 4-damage pulses, small 1HP ally heals and slow. Gives up teleporting and the departure bomb.

attack.name: Burrow Cover
attack.description: Place a 3s burrow field with six 4-damage pulses, small 1HP ally heals and slow. Gives up teleporting and the departure bomb.
